Name: Woods elsewhere
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]

I've always lacked wood, so I made this map which aims to be discreet but efficient if you need materials especially when you're at the start of the game.This mod adds a warp for another forest map at the bus stop which takes you to the Mountain elsewhere.You could also plant seasonal stuff there, or catch upland fish or put crab pots in the stream, there are lots of trees you can cut, some berry bushes, etc.
If you need stone it's easy, any mine has it, but if you need wood... for wood the game is unbalanced compared to stone, you will no longer have to strip all the maps to get it, just come here and get that what you need.
The map has two other warps, the minecart in the Woods Elsewhere takes you to the mountain and the large obelisk takes you to the beach, a quick way to get where you need to go, one way.
Compatible with most mods out there like RSV, SVE, etc.

This project is in an experimental phase, perhaps over time I could add more to it.I gladly accept advice or collaboration to improve the project.

Installation: unzip the file and paste it into the Stardew Valley Mods folder and don't forget to download the requirements. Remove the old and install the new.

I improved the compatibility, now it just adds that tile, I don't have any expansions and it should be compatible with almost everything, let me know.
Version 1.0.3 Add Stumps random and seasonal forage.
Version 1.0.4 I excluded npc's from this map, so they will not change paths.
Version 1.0.5 Updated and improved map, also changed the fishing system, no longer need EMP dependence.

I would like to include in this forest a werewolf NPC who lives here to stay away from civilization, but I don't know how to create an NPC, if anyone wants to collaborate it would be fantastic!

Thank you all for your support!
